name: epsilon
description: One op stream, Postgres to pixel — bun create blueshed/epsilon my-app. The runtime lives in your app: epsilon/, ~3.8k lines, tests included.

scripts.test: bun test epsilon/signal.test.ts epsilon/doc.test.ts epsilon/ui.test.ts epsilon/route.test.ts epsilon/cli.test.ts epsilon/law.test.ts epsilon/upgrade.test.ts
scripts.test:pg: bun test epsilon/pg.test.ts epsilon/rel.test.ts epsilon/view.test.ts epsilon/passkey.test.ts
scripts.ci: bun run db:up && bun run check && bun run test && bun run test:migrate && bun run test:pglite && bun run test:pg && bun run test:app; code=$?; bun run db:down; exit $code
